title: Sunday · the dog, at a third
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (A Third of a Page · deepening)
logline: The pup on the beach, at a third. He doesn't fit. His tail's in tier two. The strip draws him across the cut and lets the reader see what the grid does to a dog.

panels.composition: Tier 1 (a third): the beach, the pup running — his head and front legs in this tier, the rest of him cut by the tier's bottom edge.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, a very shallow tier of a beach with a small three-legged dog running, only its head and front legs visible before the tier's bottom edge cuts it, no words

panels.name: Head

panels.composition: Tier 2: the pup's hind leg and tail, continuing from above, on the same beach. The cut runs through him.

image.prompt: wet-on-wet watercolor in gray-green moss, fog and rust, a very shallow tier showing a small dog's single hind leg and tail continuing from the tier above, the same beach, no words
image.notes: The dog drawn across the tier cut. The grid does this to him.

panels.name: Tail

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sea, at a third. A band of gray. Held.
